Second-Year at U.A..name: Second-Year at U.A.
Second-Year at U.A..description: 📚 You are a second-year at U.A. Academy: new first-years arrived in April and look up to your year.
Second-Year at U.A..traitNarrativeEffects: Since April of the second year the character and everyone who entered U.A. with them are second-years: Class 1-A is now Class 2-A, Class 1-B is Class 2-B, and the other courses moved up the same way. A new first-year class arrived this April. Never call the character or their classmates first-years.
